WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
sales_by_month AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date)) AS sales_year,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date)) AS sales_month,
        SUM(f.gross_amount) AS gross_sales_incl_vat
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date)) = 2024
      AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date)) IN (8, 9)
    GROUP BY 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date)),
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date))
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN sales_month = 8 THEN 'August 2024'
        WHEN sales_month = 9 THEN 'September 2024'
    END AS month,
    gross_sales_incl_vat
FROM sales_by_month
ORDER BY sales_month
